transcript: what's the point of tracking the jobs you apply to wouldn't it be easier to just apply and not worry about it again unless they email you back and I get it because I've been on the job search myself and know what it feels like to just apply and never hear from the company again but one thing that's really nice when you do track your jobs is actually having a list of every you did apply let's face it we are just scrolling and applying to jobs all day if we're on the job search and it's really easy to forget where you applied already maybe I'm a nerd but data can be fun but let me show you what may be the best reason for using this free job search tracker from teal let's say I applied to this job at du lingo a month ago it took them a while but now they've reached out to me for an interview but when I go back to their job board this job is no longer posted they've taken it down but with the teal job tracker it's still here the keywords are still highlighted and I can review and prep before my interview and it doesn't matter that they've taken this off of their own website but this whole thing's free try and see if you like doing it for yourself
